moments.title: The Hundred Season Underway
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament is in full swing across the UK, with matches daily and teams like Welsh Fire competing in the 100-ball format until August 16.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: The Hundred is serving up short-form cricket thrills across the UK! Who are you backing to go all the way?

angles.name: Welsh Fire Focus
angles.copy: Big week for Welsh Fire in The Hundred! Catch them in action as the tournament heats up. Are you heading to Cardiff?

moments.title: Boardmasters Festival Approaches
moments.blurb: Cornwall's Boardmasters Festival returns August 5-9, bringing a massive line-up including Fatboy Slim, The Kooks, James Arthur, and Dizzee Rascal to Watergate Bay and Fistral Beach.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Only 8 days until Boardmasters takes over Cornwall! Who are you most buzzing to see hit the stage?

angles.name: Line-up Highlight
angles.copy: From Fatboy Slim to The Kooks, Boardmasters has something for everyone. Get ready for five days of surf and sound!

moments.title: Wales Airshow Soars in Swansea
moments.blurb: The spectacular Wales Airshow delighted crowds over the weekend (July 25-26) in Swansea Bay, featuring breathtaking aerial displays and a new 'Afterburn' evening show.

angles.name: Weekend Recap
angles.copy: Still buzzing from the Wales Airshow in Swansea Bay? What was your favourite display from the weekend?

angles.name: Local Shoutout
angles.copy: Swansea Bay was the place to be this weekend for the incredible Wales Airshow. Did you catch the 'Afterburn' show?

moments.title: Glastonbury Pride Celebrated
moments.blurb: Glastonbury Pride, a vibrant grassroots event, was celebrated in the Somerset town on Sunday, July 26, showcasing community spirit and diversity.

angles.name: Pride Reflect
angles.copy: Glastonbury celebrated its grassroots Pride event on Sunday. A fantastic display of community and inclusivity!

angles.name: Community Focus
angles.copy: Big shout out to everyone who made Glastonbury Pride on Sunday such a wonderful and colourful event!

moments.title: James Hetfield Turns 63
moments.blurb: Metallica frontman James Hetfield celebrates his 63rd birthday on August 3.

angles.name: Metallica Icon
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to the legendary James Hetfield! What's your all-time favourite Metallica track?

angles.name: Rock Royalty
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy Birthday to James Hetfield of Metallica! Still bringing the thunder at 63.

moments.title: Bruce Dickinson Turns 68
moments.blurb: Iron Maiden's iconic vocalist Bruce Dickinson celebrates his 68th birthday on August 7.

angles.name: Maiden Legend
angles.copy: Up the Irons! Happy 68th Birthday to the one and only Bruce Dickinson from Iron Maiden. What's your favourite Maiden album?

angles.name: Rock Voice
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy Birthday to Iron Maiden's incredible frontman, Bruce Dickinson! Still soaring high at 68.

moments.title: UK Singles Chart Buzz
moments.blurb: ANOTR ft. 54 Ultra's 'Talk To You' is a strong contender for the summer anthem, while Shakira and Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' remains high on the UK Singles Chart.

angles.name: Summer Anthem Race
angles.copy: Is 'Talk To You' by ANOTR ft. 54 Ultra your Official Song of the Summer? It's making serious waves on the charts!

angles.name: Chart Movers
angles.copy: Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' is still a major player on the UK Singles Chart. What's your current favourite track?
